messages:
nina: dropped a small thread about trace permalinks + export clarity. prototype: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd/trace-permalink-v2
sam: nice. primary ask: when users copy corr-id we should optionally give a permalink to the trace, not just the id. many users paste links into tickets.
oliver: agreed, but security: permalink must respect RBAC and expiry for private deployments. suggest expiry toggle in the copy menu: 'Copy id' vs 'Copy link (24h)'.
mae: UX question: how do we present that affordance without clutter? maybe a tiny chevron on the copy icon that reveals a micro-menu: Copy id, Copy permanent link (if allowed), Copy expiring link (24h).
aisha: accessibility: ensure micro-menu is keyboard navigable and the items have clear aria-labels. for SRs, announce the link type when copied, e.g., 'Expiring trace link copied'.
sam: copy feedback: rather than toast, anchor a non-reflow inline pill 'Link copied' near the action for 1.5s + aria-live region message for SRs. toasts get lost in dense dashboards.
oliver: export nuance: some users asked for partial-span export (just spans related to error) vs full trace. modal should explain differences: 'Full trace: all spans and logs' vs 'Error-focused: spans touching the error node'. add an estimate of size for each.
nina: good. also add clear filenames: default 'trace-<id>-full.json' or 'trace-<id>-error.json'. users complained about ambiguous filenames in downloads.
mae: keyboard shortcut idea for copy link: C when focus is on the corr-id (with modifier). show shortcut in tooltip and in accessibility docs. ensure not to collide with browser shortcuts.
aisha: confirm SR announcement strings: 'Correlation id copied', 'Trace link copied', 'Expiring trace link copied (expires in 24 hours)'. use role=status and polite live region.
sam: visual density: micro-menu should be 160px max width, use icons + labels. default action when pressing Enter on copy icon should be 'Copy id' not open menu. hitting Alt+Down (or Space?) opens the menu. document keyboard map.
oliver: for privacy: for private deployments include a small lock icon on permalinks to indicate auth required. hover text: 'Requires authentication'.
nina: analytics: track copy_id, copy_permalink, download_full, download_error_focused with properties: trace_id, user_tier, export_size_estimate.
mae: one more tiny: when copying permalink, include UTM-like param for support source ?src=support so pasted links from support tickets can surface special help UI. need privacy review but useful.
aisha: ensure any added query params do not leak PII and are documented. also SR: include actual href text in announcement so screen reader users can confirm link content.
nina: thanks all. i'll sketch the micro-menu patterns, copy behaviors, and update the export modal copy + filenames. will push frames and a11y notes, ping when ready for quick sign-off.
bot-deploy: reminder: run a11y checklist and automated link-scan: https://internal.redwood/ops/link-scan
